# ixapi_de_cix_cloud_router_prefix_list (Resource)

Use the `ixapi_de_cix_cloud_router_prefix_list` resource to manage a prefix list for BGP route filtering.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ixapi_account" "customer" {
  external_ref = "my_account"
}

resource "ixapi_de_cix_cloud_router_prefix_list" "example" {
  name              = "my-prefix-list"
  managing_account  = data.ixapi_account.customer.id
  consuming_account = data.ixapi_account.customer.id

  match_list {
    prefix     = "10.0.0.0/8"
    min_length = 8
    max_length = 24
  }
  match_list {
    prefix     = "192.168.0.0/16"
    min_length = 16
    max_length = 28
  }
}

output "prefix_list_id" {
  value = ixapi_de_cix_cloud_router_prefix_list.example.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `consuming_account` (String) Consuming account ID
- `managing_account` (String) Managing account ID
- `match_list` (Block List, Min: 1) List of prefix matches (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--match_list))
- `name` (String) Name of the prefix list

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedblock--match_list"></a>
### Nested Schema for `match_list`

Required:

- `prefix` (String) IP prefix in CIDR notation (e.g., 192.168.0.0/16)

Optional:

- `max_length` (Number) Maximum prefix length to match
- `min_length` (Number) Minimum prefix length to match
